whySell: Proven, sustained global demand: 5,514 ratings on the branded Amazon ASIN, 829 on Walmart, and a French AliExpress comparable showing 50,000+ sold
Perfect video-ad product: the 'sit on a raw egg without breaking it' demo is instantly understandable, filmable, and hook-rich for TikTok/Reels/Meta
Strong price ladder: generic landed cost ~1,080 DZD supports retail at 2,900-3,900 DZD — a 60-70% gross margin at plausible Algerian price points
Light (~0.7-1.1 kg packed), non-fragile, no sizing/fit problems, low after-sales burden — well suited to COD logistics and 58-wilaya courier networks
Dual year-round angles (back/tailbone relief for office & driving) plus a strong summer cooling hook for seasonal spikes
No verified dedicated local seller of this design found on Ouedkniss — partial whitespace vs. generic gel cushions priced 2,000-11,000 DZD
risks: IP risk: 'EGG SITTER' is a registered EU/US trademark and the honeycomb design holds US/EU design patents — sell under generic naming ('coussin gel nid d'abeille'), never use brand name, packaging, or copied images
Quality variance in cheap TPE generics: Jumia Egypt/Kenya listings show 2.0-3.7 ratings with 'fake/thin' complaints — supplier sample testing is mandatory
Algeria import friction: 30% duty (assumed, TBC) + 19% VAT on CIF, plus import-licensing/forwarde constraints — landed cost must be confirmed with a transitaire before scaling
COD economics are CPA-sensitive: at 56% effective delivery rate, profit at 3,500 DZD turns negative above ~585 DZD CPA per placed order — bundle offers (2-pack) materially improve survivability
Low-grade gel can deform in hot cars or emit odor in summer heat — quality spec must be enforced (density 700 g+, TPE grade)
Medical claims (treatment of sciatica, hemorrhoids, discs) are unsupported and risk ad rejection — comfort/relief language only
Algeria demand is an unvalidated hypothesis extrapolated from foreign marketplaces and substitute listings
